data.name: Almos – A Dream Painter's Tale
data.detailed_description:
Features

  • Explore a hand-crafted interconnected Metroidvania world inspired by dreams and nightmares.

  • Master a fast, skill-based combat system focused on movement, parries, stance breaks, and aerial combos.

  • Harness Color, a unique combat resource used for magic, healing, and tactical decision-making.

  • Create your own playstyle through a modular spellcrafting system combining Dreams, Threads, and Wonders.

  • Discover powerful Talismans that encourage unique builds and long-term character progression.

  • Traverse diverse dream domains, each introducing exclusive environmental mechanics and traversal challenges.

  • Face memorable bosses with distinct mechanics and multiple combat phases.

  • Uncover a mysterious narrative about identity, memory, sacrifice, and the true nature of dreams.

  • Restore life and color to a world consumed by darkness.


About the Game

A world without color should not exist.

Awaken in the mysterious World of Dream-Making, a realm where every dream ever dreamt is brought to life. What was once a vibrant world has been consumed by the Nightmare, leaving entire domains drained of color and overrun by twisted creatures born from forgotten fears.

Take on the role of Luka, a human boy trapped in this dying world, and fight alongside the Dream Painter Almos to restore its lost colors and uncover the truth behind the Nightmare.

Explore a vast, interconnected world filled with hidden paths, memorable characters, dangerous creatures, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Master a fast-paced combat system that seamlessly blends swordplay, movement, and magic, while building your own playstyle through customizable spells and talismans.

Every battle leaves behind Color, the world's most valuable resource. Absorb it to cast powerful spells and heal your wounds, or leave it behind to gain unique combat advantages. Managing Color becomes a constant tactical decision, shaping every encounter.

As you journey through surreal dream domains, unlock powerful movement abilities, overcome environmental challenges, and discover unique mechanics that make each area feel distinct. Swing through ancient forests, manipulate the environment, solve traversal puzzles, and uncover places hidden from those who fail to pay attention.

Behind every restored landscape lies another piece of the world's forgotten history. Every Dream Painter carries a secret. Every Nightmare has a purpose.

As the boundaries between dreams and reality begin to blur, long forgotten truths come to light. In a world where nothing is quite what it seems, can you uncover the real threat before everything fades into darkness?
